title: Magic Girl World Compact Card Effects v1

oneOf.description: 受限公式：支持 + - * / %、比较、逻辑、最外层三元式，以及纯数学函数 floor/ceil/abs/min/max；不支持其他函数或 JavaScript。% 可表达每 N 次。状态类型可读取 self/opponent.has_buff、has_debuff、has_neutral、has_status 与对应 *_count。

lifecycle.description: Optional independent card departure rules; explicit timing overrides legacy flags. exhaust is this combat; purge permanently removes this owned card, never its temporary copy's parent.

on_discard.description: Every real discard from hand, including turn cleanup; playing and scry are not discard. remove leaves combat without entering the recoverable exhaust pile; purge permanently removes the exact owned instance.

removable.description: false: cannot permanently remove the owned card; combat removal still works and the original survives battle.

transformable.description: false: cannot transform in or out of battle; independent of removal permission.

sly.description: 灵巧：回合结束清理前从手牌被主动或效果弃置时，免费打出并完整结算；回合末自动弃牌不触发。

formulaString.description: 布尔条件公式；支持比较、&&、||、!，以及 self/opponent.has_buff、has_debuff、has_neutral、has_status。每 N 次可用计数器 % N == 0。
